race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: THEFLYINGKING may have his quirks but sets the standard and should be well up to winning a race of this nature. Bumper winner Sparkling Wit is bred to be at least smart over jumps and entitled to be in the mix, with Border Lad , Ravendark and Sine Qua Non others to consider. THEFLYINGKING (IRE) SPARKLING WIT (IRE) BORDER LAD (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Theflyingking (9/4), Sparkling Wit (3/1), Sine Qua Non (4/1), Border Lad (4/1), Angelo Dundee (12/1), Ravendark (16/1), C'est Le Capri (16/1), Excessivebehaviour (16/1), Strange Ways (25/1), Beechwood Road (33/1), Call Of Freedom (33/1), Sharp As Glass (50/1), Any News For Me (50/1), Inthelineoffire (50/1), Grey Balls Of Fire (66/1), Highland Trail (100/1)
